title: Carrier jump escape retention and generic primary recipient outline
acceptance_criteria: Portable escape pairs the body's position with its canonical pin root frame, retaining five-second progress during carrier jumps while keeping true relative displacement, damage, incapacity and stale custody cancellation.

Registered player holder jump input attests the old mixed-frame displacement exceeds 0.3 while the canonical frame stays stable; the original escape operation/start tick survives and releases the original committed mouse.

One primary target resolver feeds ordinary clicks, gameplay-window clicks and entity outline nomination; held medical items highlight the actual generic living recipient and non-body routes preserve item/block fallback and pickup priority.
Canonical containment pinning and frame cleanup reuse the existing owner service, preserve strict release transactions and do not change camera, prototype capability or physical jump rules.

Fresh focused JVM, full native, affected UI/interaction/prediction readiness and isolated client startup pass before packaging; connected outlines/input and continuous-jump presentation remain manual or unresolved.
manual_steps: As a held playable mouse, start escape. Have the holder repeatedly jump while moving: the same five-second progress should finish rather than restart. Check backpack escape too.

Hold a bruise pack, analyzer or syringe and aim at a mouse and another supported character: the white outline should match the clicked body. With an unrelated item, check the appropriate item/block fallback rather than a misleading mob outline.
Check true damage/incapacity/drop interruption and r38 held-camera smoothness remain intact. Same-holder physical hand-transfer escape and continuous-jump observer landings are not claimed fixed.
